r1_pair.title: Speaking about vision, talking in the name of so much more: A methodological framework for ventriloquial analyses in organization studies
r1_pair.authors: Ellen Nathues, Mark van Vuuren, François Cooren

A.executive_summary:
Problema: Organizations have long been treated as stable and fixed entities, defined by concrete buildings, catchy names, and strategic goals neatly written on paper. Besides organizational objects and ceremonials, however, organizational scholars need to consider how communicative and symbolic practices influence which organizational phenomena come into existence. (p.1 L023-027)

Abordagem teórica: The Communicative Constitution of Organizations (CCO) school proposes an alternative, practice-grounded conceptualization for studying organizations as emerging in communicative (inter)actions. (p.1 L024-026) 

Método: Five focus groups with 23 participants at the employee level in four German organizations: a regional bank, a fire brigade, a hospital, and a direct-selling business for sensual products. Ventriloquial analyses were carried out. (p.5 L225-L229) 

Achados: We created a four-step framework for ventriloquial analyses and explored how visions are talked into existence. (p.1 L031-032) The four-step framework comprises identifying, grouping and assigning activities, relating, showing. (p.6 L241-250)  

Contribuição: We thus provide organizational (communication) scholars with
a new methodological tool that facilitates the systematic inquiry into organizing and the organized from a communicative constitutive perspective. (p.1 L033-035)
A.research_question: How are employee conversations about visions—a classic constituent of organizations—"talked" into existence? (p.1 L031-032)

theory_verdicts.name: Visão organizacional (vision) como objeto de estudo

key_concepts.definition:
“... identifying in the name of what or whom a given actor appears to speak” (Cooren, 2010a, p. 135; italics in original). It hereby also consists of identifying what animates this actor, an animation that often is to be found in the attachment a person expresses vis-a-vis what she is ventriloquizing." (p.4 L165-168). In other words, “Ventriloquism is about speaking and acting in the name of other beings (the command structure, the CEO’s order) in order to make a convincing case for some other beings or audiences (Cooren & Sandler, 2014)” (p.4 L183-185).
Ventriloquism (Cooren, 2010a) illustrates how human interactants can give voice to other beings (they ventriloquize a hygrometer, camera, or declaration) as well as how humans can come to speak and act for other things (they are ventriloquized by a value, feeling, principle, etc.; Brummans & Cooren, 2011; Cooren, 2012; Cooren & Sandler, 2014) (p.3 L110-114). Ventriloquism aligns with CCO’s core premise of simultaneously engaging ideas of the material and linguistic turns (Schoeneborn et al., 2019), but is unique in its decentered consideration of agency and materiality as conversational resources rather than physical manifestations. In so doing, ventriloquism can ascribe agentic qualities even to absent, missing, or not-yet-existing beings, as long as they materialize—come to matter—in communicative turns (Cooren, 2018). (p.4 L155-160).

is not merely "intentionality, choice, and selfhood" (Martin, Sugarman, & Hickinbottom, 2010). For the Montreal school, and in line with Bruno Latour (1996, 2005), agency encompasses “a broader sense to include everything that appears to make a difference or to do something in a situation (Bencherki, 2016; Caronia & Cooren, 2014; Cooren, 2004)”. (p.3 L114-118) Agency thus gains a relational ontology, being understood “as a joint mediation shared among various beings (Caronia & Cooren, 2014; Cooren, Fairhurst, & Huët, 2012; Kuhn, Ashcraft, & Cooren, 2017) that altogether co-enact a situation (Cooren et al., 2013; Cooren & Bencherki, 2010).” (p.3 L132-135)

Visions express long-term goals and provide direction, they are ubiquitous in organizations and associated with effective leadership (Carton, Murphy, & Clark, 2014; Kantabutra & Avery, 2010). (p.5 L217-218). Visions appear to be multi-focal, multi-vocal, and central in organizations (p.5 L222). Framework for vision as practice (p.10 L462-521)

methodology.sector: a regional bank, a fire brigade, a hospital, and a direct-selling business for sensual products. (p.5 L225-L229)
methodology.analysis_note: Ventriloquial analysis (inspired by Bakhtinian discourse analysis)

main_findings.finding: A framework for ventriloquial analyses, encompassing the four phases: 1) identifying explicit and implicit invocations (figures) and animations (vents); 2) grouping vents and figures into clusters and assigning activities to clusters; 3) relating clusters and collections to main voices by tracing back chains of authorship, and showing/presenting findings through vignettes of real-data excerpts.

Ventriloquial analysis of visionary talk: Ventriloquial analyses can help identify sources for strategists’ claims, beyond conventional abstractions. Strategists need to present a vision that is worthy to be ventriloquized by members and that they themselves ventriloquize in their behavior. Communicative materializations are given by connecting an abstract concept to the specific people, things, and sources that talk vision into being through ventriloquial dynamics—or not (Cooren, 2010a). This stresses how visions’ connection to activities, values, etc. is key to make visions matter for organization members. Accordingly, the authors suggest perceiving visions as visionary in the truest sense of this word, as detailed verbal portraits that easily and truthfully materialize in figures of everyday practice.

contribution.theoretical:
Methodological contribution: Our paper offers organizational (communication) scholars a methodological tool that can systematically guide them through ventriloquial analyses, that is, through identifying what leads a person to say what she is saying or what voice can be recognized in what she is saying. It thus offers a framework that helps explain how organizational elements are talked into existence, by uncovering what substantiates them in everyday communication (Cooren, 2010b). (p.16 L935-942)
The framework’s systematicity promotes the inclusiveness of ventriloquial analyses as the three analytical questions account both for the palpable character of figures (i.e., explicit and implicit) and ventriloquism’s essential bi-directionality (i.e., including vents, which have mostly been absent from previous ventriloquial studies, e.g., Long et al., 2018). (p.16 L945-949)
Our framework supplements the nouns of vents and figures with verbs (phase 2). In so doing, and in contrast to previous ventriloquial analyses (e.g., Long et al.,2018), our framework answers not only the question of what communicatively constitutes realities but likewise the question of how voices enter interactions. We consider this dimension a crucial addition as it highlights the continually in flux and processual character of organizational phenomena that the communicative constitutive school advocates (see also Langley & Tsoukas, 2017). (p.17 L966-971)
contribution.practical:
(...) “we encourage methodological papers to focus on (a) identifying ventriloquial effects and (b) presenting findings, as these activities appeared most decisive for performing a ventriloquial analysis.” (p.17 L982-984)
(...) “we encourage scholars to apply our framework and embark on ventriloquial explorations of organizational phenomena, including values, missions, and identities”. (p.17 L995-996) 
"Such analyses will not only help in advancing our understanding of the communicative practices that constitute organizational realities, situations, and activities, but will also contribute to further breaking up the perpetual disconnect between the various voices that materialize (themselves) in interaction, conversation, and sensemaking." (p.17 L1001-1005)
"The framework we have presented can itself be seen as speaking in the name of other voices, such as our experiences, thoughts, and discussions, scholars and articles that inspired and guided us, our focus group participants, the inspiring voice of a great mentor, and many more. What we envision is this number of voices growing in future research. And for that, we hope that this paper will animate deep thinking, insightful exploration, and systematic application." (p.18 L1008-1012)

B.executive_summary: O artigo propõe um quadro metodológico em quatro fases para análises ventríloquas em estudos organizacionais, a partir da perspectiva da constituição comunicativa das organizações (CCO) (p.1/L024-035; p.2/L080-084). Os autores partem do ventriloquismo, conceito da escola de Montreal segundo o qual as pessoas dão voz a outros seres, como políticas, fatos e valores, e ao mesmo tempo são levadas a falar por eles, o que decentra a agência e a trata de modo relacional (p.2/L051-065; p.3/L131-139). Argumentam que o conceito é atraente, mas carece de meios concretos para identificar atos ventríloquos (p.2/L066-072; p.5/L210-214). O quadro distingue figures, invocados explícita ou implicitamente, e vents, que animam quem fala, e organiza a análise em identificar, agrupar e atribuir atividades, relacionar por cadeias de autoria e mostrar com vinhetas (p.5/L190-209; p.6/L238-254). Para desenvolvê-lo e ilustrá-lo, estudaram conversas de funcionários sobre visões organizacionais em cinco grupos focais com 23 participantes de quatro organizações alemãs (banco, corpo de bombeiros, hospital e venda direta), com 117 páginas de transcrição analisadas no Atlas.ti (p.2/L084-089; p.5/L225-235; p.6/L262-265). A análise gerou 243 vents e figures, 59 clusters e 24 coleções, relacionados a vozes gerenciais e de equipe (p.7/L299-300; p.8/L409-411; p.9/L424-428; p.9/L430-438). As quatro vinhetas mostram funcionários traduzindo visões abstratas em práticas concretas e confirmando ou contestando a visão oficial por meio de figuras do cotidiano (p.11/L586-652; p.12/L653-663; p.13/L740-747; p.14/L807-813; p.15/L898-904). Concluem que as visões se materializam ao serem relacionadas à prática e que estrategistas devem apresentar visões dignas de serem ventriloquizadas (p.16/L909-930). Propõem refinar o quadro e aplicá-lo a valores, missões, identidades e fazer estratégia (p.17/L981-1005).
B.research_question: O artigo não enuncia uma pergunta de pesquisa formal; declara como contribuição principal um quadro metodológico para o ventriloquismo (p.2/L080-084). Reconstruída como pergunta implícita: como identificar, ordenar e apresentar sistematicamente efeitos ventríloquos, isto é, o que leva uma pessoa a dizer o que diz e que vozes se reconhecem no que diz, para mostrar como as visões são faladas à existência (p.2/L066-072; p.1/L029-035).

theory_verdicts.name: Constituição comunicativa das organizações (CCO)
theory_verdicts.quote: propagates a more fluid outlook where organizations emerge in communication, through interaction
theory_verdicts.note: A perspectiva CCO é o referencial geral no qual o ventriloquismo se insere.

theory_verdicts.name: Ventriloquismo organizacional
theory_verdicts.quote: Ventriloquism illustrates how people give voice to other beings—policies, missions, facts, persons, etc.—that can then be deemed as participating in an interaction
theory_verdicts.note: Conceito central cujo método o artigo desenvolve.

theory_verdicts.name: Teoria da estruturação
theory_verdicts.note: A teoria da estruturação não é mencionada.

theory_verdicts.name: Ontologia relacional da agência
theory_verdicts.quote: ventriloquism conceives of agency from a relational ontology, that is, as a joint mediation shared among various beings
theory_verdicts.note: A agência relacional fundamenta a noção de vents e figures.

theory_verdicts.name: Visão organizacional (vision) como objeto de estudo
theory_verdicts.quote: Visions express long-term goals and provide direction, they are ubiquitous in organizations and associated with effective leadership
theory_verdicts.note: A visão organizacional é o gênero de fala usado como caso empírico para desenvolver o quadro.

theory_verdicts.name: Abordagens do discurso organizacional
theory_verdicts.quote: a ventriloquial approach negates the classical divide between what constitutes the interactional scene
theory_verdicts.note: Contrasta a abordagem ventríloqua com outras abordagens do discurso organizacional.

theory_verdicts.name: Teoria da complexidade organizacional
theory_verdicts.note: A teoria da complexidade organizacional não é mencionada; 'complexities' aparece só em sentido geral (p.17/L989).

theory_verdicts.name: Teoria ator-rede
theory_verdicts.note: Latour é citado apenas como apoio a um raciocínio sobre agência de objetos (p.3/L122) e em referências, sem desenvolver a teoria ator-rede.

theory_verdicts.name: Pensamento processual
theory_verdicts.note: Pensamento processual aparece em uma citação de passagem (p.17/L970-971), sem desenvolvimento.

theory_verdicts.name: Polifonia e dialogismo
theory_verdicts.note: 'Polyphony' e 'dialogicity' aparecem só em títulos de referências (p.18/L1050-1051; p.19/L1088); o texto trata de 'múltiplas vozes' pelo ventriloquismo, sem teoria polifônica própria.

theory_verdicts.name: Estratégia/vision-making como prática
theory_verdicts.note: Estratégia e fazer estratégia aparecem como aplicação futura sugerida (p.17/L998-1001) e como ligação com estrategistas (p.16/L925-930), sem abordagem de estratégia como prática.

key_concepts.definition: Perspectiva segundo a qual as organizações emergem e se realizam em práticas comunicativas, interativas e dinâmicas, e não como entidades estáveis e fixas.
key_concepts.quote: propagates a more fluid outlook where organizations emerge in communication, through interaction

key_concepts.definition: Processo pelo qual as pessoas dão voz a outros seres (políticas, missões, fatos, pessoas) que passam a participar da interação, ao mesmo tempo em que são levadas a falar por eles; humanos são ventríloquos e bonecos.
key_concepts.quote: Ventriloquism illustrates how people give voice to other beings—policies, missions, facts, persons, etc.—that can then be deemed as participating in an interaction

key_concepts.definition: Figures são seres invocados e feitos falar por alguém; vents são o que leva as pessoas a dizer o que dizem e a agir como agem.
key_concepts.quote: Analyzing communication episodes from a ventriloquial perspective thus amounts to identifying, on the one hand, the figures that are implicitly or explicitly invoked and made to say things by people, and on the other hand, the vents that lead people to say what they say and act how they act

key_concepts.definition: Na invocação explícita, o enunciado menciona diretamente a figura; na implícita, a figura está envolvida no enunciado e precisa ser desdobrada pelo analista.
key_concepts.quote: An explicit invocation means that the utterance directly mentions the figure

key_concepts.definition: Concepção de agência como mediação conjunta compartilhada entre vários seres, que inclui tudo o que faz diferença ou faz algo em uma situação.
key_concepts.quote: ventriloquism conceives of agency from a relational ontology, that is, as a joint mediation shared among various beings

key_concepts.concept: Quadro de quatro fases para análises ventríloquas
key_concepts.definition: Quadro proposto pelos autores: identificar vents e figures; agrupar em clusters e coleções e atribuir atividades; relacionar com vozes principais por cadeias de autoria; mostrar achados com vinhetas.
key_concepts.quote: Our ventriloquial framework comprises four phases, summarized in Table 1

methodology.design: Desenvolvimento de um quadro metodológico por iteração entre a revisão de análises ventríloquas anteriores e a análise de conversas de funcionários sobre visões, ilustrado com quatro vinhetas.
methodology.sample_type: funcionários (sem gerência, RH, marketing e comunicação) de quatro organizações alemãs: banco regional, corpo de bombeiros, hospital e empresa de venda direta
methodology.sector: banco, corpo de bombeiros, hospital e venda direta
methods: análise temática por clusters e coleções
methodology.analysis_note: Foram realizados cinco grupos focais (dois na empresa de venda direta) com 23 participantes, conduzidos pela primeira autora (p.5/L225-235), gravados, transcritos, traduzidos do alemão e codificados no Atlas.ti, com 117 páginas de transcrição (p.6/L262-265). A análise seguiu as quatro fases do quadro e gerou 243 vents e figures, 59 clusters, dez atividades e 24 coleções (p.7/L299-300; p.8/L409-411; p.9/L421-428).

main_findings.finding: O quadro metodológico tem quatro fases: identificar, agrupar e atribuir atividades, relacionar e mostrar efeitos ventríloquos.
main_findings.quote: Our ventriloquial framework comprises four phases, summarized in Table 1

main_findings.finding: A análise das conversas sobre visões produziu 243 vents e figures, agrupados em 59 clusters e 24 coleções, ligados a vozes gerenciais e de equipe.
main_findings.quote: which resulted in a list of 243 vents and figures

main_findings.finding: Funcionários traduzem visões abstratas em comportamentos e práticas concretas, e princípios como pôr o paciente em primeiro lugar animam essa tradução.
main_findings.quote: we see how a lot of work is done to concretize what at first sight looks like an abstract vision

main_findings.finding: Quando a visão oficial condiz com a experiência cotidiana, os participantes mobilizam figuras que a confirmam.
main_findings.quote: ventriloquation consists of mobilizing multiple figures that are implicitly or explicitly presented as confirming the truthfulness of the organization’s vision

main_findings.finding: Quando a visão oficial destoa da experiência, os participantes a contestam por figuras de seu trabalho, e o abstrato se separa do cotidiano.
main_findings.quote: participants check the official statement against multiple figures of their work experience and routine that they ventriloquize and that unanimously contradict it

main_findings.finding: Estrategistas precisam apresentar visões dignas de serem ventriloquizadas pelos membros e que eles mesmos ventriloquizem em seu comportamento.
main_findings.quote: Strategists need to present a vision that is worthy to be ventriloquized by members and that they themselves ventriloquize in their behavior

contribution.theoretical: Oferece o primeiro esboço metodológico do ventriloquismo e uma ferramenta que guia a análise sistemática da constituição comunicativa (p.2/L080-084; p.16/L932-939). Atende a pedidos de maior explicitação de métodos na CCO (p.16/L940-942), inclui os vents, em geral ausentes de estudos anteriores (p.16/L945-949), e acrescenta verbos aos substantivos de vents e figures para explicar como as vozes entram nas interações (p.17/L965-971).
contribution.practical: O artigo não traz seção de implicações gerenciais. Indica que estrategistas devem apresentar visões dignas de serem ventriloquizadas e que análises ventríloquas podem identificar fontes para suas afirmações, além de abstrações convencionais (p.16/L925-930).
